verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents an official MCP server that gives external agents such as Claude, Cursor and Copilot access to metrics, logs, traces and alerts. It also offers service accounts for programmatic API access and Agent Skills for generating queries over all three signals. Its documented debugging use cases include reconstructing a bug from a trace ID and investigating what changed after a deploy. missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes of the candidate openapi/swagger paths all returned 404), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents debugging production through these interfaces.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an external agent query metrics, logs, and traces through documented APIs to debug production

citations.quote: Connect Claude, Cursor, Copilot, and other AI agents to SigNoz via MCP for natural language access to metrics, logs, traces, and alerts.
Service accounts provide a secure way to grant programmatic API access to SigNoz without tying credentials to individual users.
